Definition: to tramp about, i.e. ramble (free or disconsolate)
BiblicalUsage: In Hebrew, rûwd means to tramp about, that is ramble (free or disconsolate). It stands in Genesis 27:40, "…thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve…", and in Hosea 11:12, "…house of Israel with deceit: but Judah yet…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God put rûwd here on purpose, and I take his word for it.
